title: 1801 Prairie's gabled section gets its round oriel and arched windows
items: On the W. W. Kimball house's 18th Street side, the gabled section now matches its c. 1895 and 1965 photographs: a round oriel window stands on a deep stepped stone corbel, with a stone balustrade around its top and three round-arched windows below it, where the wall had a plain stack of paired windows.
